title: JBSA Medical Teams deploy in support of Hurricane Harvey Relief
description: On Aug. 30, 2017, a medical team composed of Airmen from Joint Base San Antonio, TX; Keesler Air Force Base, MS; and Vance Air Force Base, OK, prepare to depart on a C5  Super Gallaxy operated by the 433rd Airlift Wing, in route to provide medical support in Houston. Amongst the Airmen was a Critical Care Air Transport Team designed to evacuate casualties and patients during combat and peacetime missions. (U.S. Air Force video by JBSA - Lackland Public Affairs)
keywords: Keesler AFB, Lackland, Harvey, evacuate, USAF, Critical Care Air Transport Team, JBSA, Joint Base San Antonio, 433rd Airlift Wing, Vance AFB, Kelly Air Annex, medical, team, Hurricane, Houston, C5
